Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.5: Food/ PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Food/ PRACTICES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Food/ PRACTICES.
2. Explain Food/ PRACTICES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food/ PRACTICES.
4. Show that you can: talk about different types of (10 Lessons)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Food/ PRACTICES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Food/ PRACTICES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
